title: 미학습 센서 적용 시 밴드별 센서 보정
hypothesis: 미학습 센서 전이(WV3→WV2 등)에서 흐리고 어두워지는 원인은 센서 간 밴드별 DN 척도 차이(밴드 평균 ÷ PAN 평균 비)이며, 입력 통계만 쓰는 밴드별 배율 보정으로 재학습 없이 세부 세기·색·RR 지표가 함께 회복된다. 같은 센서에서는 이 비율 차이가 장면 정보이므로 보정하지 않는다.
calibration: t_b = r_train_b / r_scene_b; r_train_b = ratio of channel means over the training H5 of the training sensor (sum LMS_b / sum PAN); r_scene_b = mean(LMS_b) / mean(PAN) of the input scene; network input (PAN, t*LMS, t*MS), output / t, then the K10 projection with the target sensor's operator (83 prepare)

variants.const: r_target_b = mean over the 20 target test scenes instead of the scene ratio (needs the whole test set; reported only)
variants.level: PAN and every band scaled to the training-set channel means (reported only)

guard: never applied when the target sensor is the training sensor
reference_stats_source: QB: local data/train/train_qb.h5; GF2, WV3: server C:/CtrS/PAN-MS training H5 (prepare.py --stats, CPU only)
check_rule: per pair, 'calibration effect confirmed' if cal+P beats raw+P (and raw) in RR PSNR, SAM and ERGAS on the 3-seed mean and in PSNR on every seed, for both C2MS and 65; detail energy and band bias are reported with it. Fixed before the evaluation. Not a v2.4 judgement (transfer tests are reference only)
stage0: provenance/stage0: post-hoc diagnostics on the test sets (2026-11-14, local); reference ratios of WV3/GF2 were the test-input means there
images: WV2, seed 42: C2MS vs 65 + cal + P and 65 + P vs 65 + cal + P (common/result_images.py)
device: local CPU (float64 projection; MPS has no float64)
limits: the hypothesis came from post-hoc diagnostics on the same test sets
WV2 has no training data; QB/GF2 cross-transfer is an extra check of the rule
calibration changes only the per-band scale; it cannot fix MTF differences
